_doc: LSPI binding sidecar for the Political Warfare Catalogue (PLC v1.2, upgrade-plan WS4). Alias map: corpus X -> P (preferred position), corpus Y -> Adv (adverse alternative) — mandatory; bare corpus X/Y never appear in integrated artifacts (04-SCHEMA System 1). Regenerate with tools/extract-lspi-levers.py (preserves interpretive facets). This file is an ADDITION — the catalogue itself is Mode E. Facets (required_resources, detectability, certainty_class, ethical_valence, counter_tactic_ids, provenance) populated by WS4 passes 3-6. counters_tactic_ids is the derived reciprocal of counter_tactic_ids (countered-by / counters). epsilon_template is the spec's three-place form: [a.] e_ID(<addr>/e.) -> { deltas } consuming { theta }; epsilon_tuple carries it structurally. Bare corpus lever letters appear ONLY in lspi_levers[].corpus_lever, alias_map, component_map and this note.
